chunks: And among what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from Ismāʿīl ibn Saʿdān al-Ashʿarī, from al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the takbīr in the two ʿĪds. He said: the takbīr in the first is seven takbīrs before the recitation, and in the second is five takbīrs after the recitation.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرِ: the pronouncement of 'Allāhu Akbar' in the ritual prayer
key_terms.الْأُخْرَى: the second rakʿah of the prayer
key_terms.الْأُولَى: the first rakʿah of the prayer
key_terms.الْعِيدَيْنِ: the two ʿĪd prayers, referring to ʿĪd al-Fiṭr and ʿĪd al-Aḍḥā

ai.seo_question: How many takbīrs are recited in Salat al-ʿĪdayn according to Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the ruling for the additional takbīrs in salat of the two ʿĪds. It specifies that in the first rakʿah there are seven takbīrs before the recitation, and in the second rakʿah there are five takbīrs after the recitation.
